unit_payloads.loom-autoscaler-gb10-staging.service:
[Unit]
Description=Loom gb10-arm64 external worker-pool autoscaler reconcile
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/opt/loom-staging-runner/repo
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/opt/loom-staging-runner/repo/src
ExecStart=/opt/loom-staging-runner/venv/bin/python scripts/ops/worker_pool_autoscaler_external_once.py --pool-name gb10-arm64 --namespace loom-staging --kubeconfig /etc/loom/kubeconfig/staging.yaml --db-local-port 15451 --freshness-sec 120
unit_payloads.loom-autoscaler-gb10-staging.timer:
[Unit]
Description=Run Loom gb10-arm64 external autoscaler reconcile

[Timer]
OnBootSec=45
OnUnitActiveSec=30
AccuracySec=5
Unit=loom-autoscaler-gb10-staging.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
